name: com.microsoft.identity.common.internal.ui.OpenIdVcReturnActivity
description: The shared MSAL/ADAL authentication library from Microsoft attaches a return request when it sends an OpenID Verifiable Credentials request to a verified Microsoft Authenticator handler; this Activity closes the temporary task so the app can reappear.
disableEffect: After the credential handler finishes, the return request cannot open this Activity, so the original app may not return to the foreground automatically.
